scan.target_cidr.title: Target Subnet CIDR / Host IP
scan.target_cidr.description: The IPv4 network subnet in CIDR notation or single host IP to be scanned over WinRM.

scan.protocol.title: Agentless Protocol
scan.protocol.description: Transport protocol and remote management standard used by the collector gateway.

scan.profile.title: Scan Profile
scan.profile.description: Determines the depth of WMI/CIM queries and CIS benchmark compliance rules evaluated during the scan.

scan.vault_secret_ref.title: Credential Vault Reference
scan.vault_secret_ref.description: Opaque identifier referencing encrypted credentials in the AES-256-GCM Vault Manager.

scan.gateway_id.title: Collector Gateway
scan.gateway_id.description: The local subnet collector gateway daemon executing the remote WinRM queries via mutual TLS.

admin.rollout_tier_pilot.title: Pilot Ring (Canary Tier)
admin.rollout_tier_pilot.description: When ON, scheduled scans include canary test machines (first 2-5% of fleet). When OFF, pilot ring is bypassed.
admin.rollout_tier_pilot.example: Enabled for initial patch testing and auth verification

admin.rollout_tier_staged.title: Staged Ring (Departmental Tier)
admin.rollout_tier_staged.description: When ON, scheduled scans include secondary departmental endpoints (~25% of fleet). When OFF, staged tier is skipped.

admin.rollout_tier_full.title: Full Fleet Ring (100% Production)
admin.rollout_tier_full.description: When ON, scheduled scans sweep all 400 production endpoints. When OFF, production fleet is protected from automated sweeps.
admin.rollout_tier_full.example: Enabled only after operator sign-off and pilot audit

admin.retention_strategy.title: Snapshot Retention Strategy
admin.retention_strategy.description: Specifies whether old JSONB host snapshots are exported to compressed gzip cold-storage or downsampled to weekly snapshots.
admin.retention_strategy.format: archive (Compressed GZIP on disk) | downsample (Keep 1 weekly)

admin.retention_window.title: Retention Window (Days)
admin.retention_window.description: Number of days full-resolution daily introspection snapshots are retained in PostgreSQL before archival/downsampling.

admin.test_alert_url.title: Target Webhook URL
admin.test_alert_url.description: Destination HTTPS endpoint for synthetic alerting verification (Slack, Microsoft Teams, PagerDuty, Splunk).

admin.bulk_tier_target.title: Target Rollout Tier
admin.bulk_tier_target.description: The destination tier (pilot, staged, or full) to assign selected endpoints to.

admin.bulk_tier_justification.title: Operator Justification Note
admin.bulk_tier_justification.description: Mandatory rationale recorded into the OWASP ASVS immutable security audit log.

endpoint.rollout_tier.title: Rollout Tier
endpoint.rollout_tier.description: Operational deployment ring controlling whether scheduled scan sweeps target this host.

endpoint.compliance_score.title: CIS Compliance Score
endpoint.compliance_score.description: Percentage of evaluated CIS Benchmark and NIST SP 800-53 security controls passed by this endpoint.

endpoint.bitlocker.title: BitLocker Encryption State
endpoint.bitlocker.description: Volume encryption and key protector status reported by Win32_EncryptableVolume.

endpoint.defender.title: Microsoft Defender AV Engine
endpoint.defender.description: Real-time protection state, cloud protection, and signature definition update freshness.

endpoint.tpm.title: TPM 2.0 Attestation
endpoint.tpm.description: Hardware security chip presence, spec version, and PCR measurement status.

report.ttl_hours.title: Shareable Link TTL (Hours)
report.ttl_hours.description: Time-To-Live duration before the cryptographic share link token expires and becomes inaccessible.

report.type.title: Audit Report Type
report.type.description: Focus of the report: executive fleet metrics, regulatory CIS/NIST audit, or vulnerability posture.

gateway.fingerprint.title: mTLS Certificate Fingerprint
gateway.fingerprint.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 fingerprint of the client certificate presented during mTLS 1.3 handshake.
